key.name: enable-beast-mode
key.description: Aggressive establishment: try all protocols on all servers.

key.name: enable-system-proxy
key.description: Desktop default mirrors the Psiphon Android client: apps should ride the tunnel without manual configuration. On Windows this drives the WinInet (HKCU Internet Settings) user proxy.

key.name: enable-tun
key.summary: Enable TUN routing via sing-box on connect
key.description: Whole-device routing via sing-box's own TUN with auto_route (wintun on Windows), the desktop equivalent of Android's VpnService.

key.name: tun-fakeip-dns
key.description: Answers A/AAAA queries instantly from a fake-IP pool and resolves domains at the tunnel exit. DEFAULT OFF since v1.5.0: field reports showed dead-traffic tunnels with this enabled, while the forward path (TCP DNS + cache) is proven since v1.3.1. Enable only to experiment.

key.name: cf-token
key.summary: Cloudflare API token for the helper worker
key.description: Used only against api.cloudflare.com to verify the token and deploy/update the Forough edge-helper worker. Needs Account:Read and Workers Scripts:Edit.

key.name: cf-worker-url
key.description: workers.dev URL of the deployed edge helper; used for colo and latency probes.

key.name: routing-defaults-migrated
key.description: Set after the first run of 1.3.0 enabled TUN and system proxy for installs that predate the new defaults. Later user choices are never overwritten.

key.name: inproxy-compartment-id
key.description: Used for private conduit pairing; empty means public conduits.

key.name: cdn-fronting-ip-list
key.description: IPv4 addresses or CIDRs, separated by spaces, commas, or semicolons. Used by the built-in CDN scan in fronting mode; empty means the built-in edge candidates only.

key.name: cdn-fronting-sni
key.summary: Custom CDN fronting SNI server names
key.description: Hostnames separated by spaces, commas, or semicolons. Optional companion to cdn-fronting-ip-list.

key.name: osl-urls
key.description: OSL registry root URLs, separated by spaces, commas, or semicolons. OSL carries protocol-specific server buckets (including CDN-fronted meek) that the common remote server list barely contains; empty means the remote server list only.

key.name: language
key.description: system, fa, or en. Takes effect after restart.
